mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the breathing drive was most worthwhile: the resulting picture plan connects diaphragm movement, the pleural interface and airflow in two views.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the diaphragm was comparatively uneventful on its own: the placement was clear, but its role in moving air came only with the final construction.

surprise.text: The breathing-drive picture introduced a blood CO₂ feedback arrow, broadening the construction from a nerve connection to regulation of breathing rhythm.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless: the slots and goal gave them a clear place. The CO₂ feedback connection was interesting but remained briefly explained rather than showing how a change in CO₂ adjusts rhythm.

continue.text: I would be interested in continuing, particularly to see more connections between body systems. The final mechanical explanation made the assembly worthwhile, although several intermediate fittings felt predictable.
